pages.text: I can feed mana continuously into a damaged object.

$(bold)Mana:$() 1⁄40 bucket per pulse$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Channelled$(br2)Hold a damaged, damageable item in the offhand and channel. Each paid pulse restores eight durability. Casting ends naturally when the item is fully repaired, removed, or mana runs out.
